_notes.language: One agent per language: hi-IN for the Hindi agent, en-IN for the English one (set in create_agent.py). Retell's docs say a single-language agent hears more accurately than a mixed one, and the backend knows each borrower's language before it dials. Each agent can still switch language mid-call if the borrower does.
_notes.timezone: Retell defaults to America/Los_Angeles. Must be Asia/Kolkata so time variables are in IST.
_notes.handbook_config: New Retell agents get hidden handbook presets added to the prompt. All are off so the live agent runs exactly the prompt the test lab runs.
_notes.interruption_sensitivity: Slightly below the default of 1 so short backchannels like 'haan' or 'hmm' on noisy lines do not cut Meera off.
_notes.max_call_duration_ms: 12 minutes, matching the pre-dial rule that no call starts after 18:45.
_notes.data_storage_retention_days: At least six months, as RBI requires for recovery call recordings.
_notes.pii_config: Scrubs card, bank account, password and PIN data from stored transcripts and recordings, for borrowers who read out a code unprompted.
_notes.voicemail_option: Hang up without a message so nothing is disclosed to whoever hears the voicemail.
_notes.temperature: Google strongly recommends the default 1.0 for all Gemini 3 models; lower values can hurt reasoning (ai.google.dev Gemini 3 developer guide). The lab's open model has its own setting, LAB_AGENT_TEMPERATURE.
_notes.voice: Monika (en-IN), ElevenLabs, chosen by listening to previews. eleven_flash_v2_5 is fast and supports Hindi and English (Retell language support page).
_notes.voice_tuning: After the v2 voice test (21 Oct 2026): faster speech (1.15), steadier voice (temperature 0.5) and accurate speech recognition, because the caller found the voice slow and breathy and Hinglish was misheard.
_notes.default_dynamic_variables: Built by create_agent.py from a fictional borrower for each language (Sunil Verma for Hindi, Mohit Sethi for English), so a dashboard test call has every variable filled.
